title: E-Beam Inspection - Voids Detection on ATL/LMS IPRO8
subtitle: Pre-Diffusion Quality Validation for 65nm Node Manufacturing
author: Dr. Priya Sharma

sections.1_OBJECTIVE:
This test case validates the capability of the ATL/LMS IPRO8 system to detect and classify Voids defects during pre-diffusion inspection at the 65nm technology node. The test is conducted at Chandler Fab 42 to ensure manufacturing quality standards are met for 450mm wafer production.

The primary objective is to verify that the inspection system meets the required detection sensitivity and classification accuracy for Voids defects that are critical to yield at the 65nm node. This test case is part of the ongoing qualification program for the ATL/LMS IPRO8 platform.
sections.2_SCOPE:
- Product Line: ATL/LMS IPRO8
- Inspection Type: E-Beam Inspection
- Target Defect: Voids
- Process Step: Pre-Diffusion
- Wafer Size: 450mm
- Technology Node: 65nm
- Fab Location: Chandler Fab 42

This test case applies to all ATL/LMS IPRO8 systems deployed at Chandler Fab 42 for pre-diffusion monitoring in the 65nm manufacturing line. Results from this test are used to establish baseline performance metrics and to qualify new recipe configurations.
sections.3_TEST_CONFIGURATION:
System: ATL/LMS IPRO8
Software Version: v14.0.224
Recipe: E-BEAM_INSPECTION_65nm_PRE_DIFFUSION
Illumination Mode: Brightfield
Scan Speed: Medium (113 mm/s)
Pixel Size: 0.25μm
Edge Exclusion: 4mm
Sampling Plan: Full wafer sampling
sections.4_TEST_PROCEDURE:
1. Power on the ATL/LMS IPRO8 system and allow 30-minute warm-up period.
2. Load the calibration wafer and run the standard calibration routine.
3. Verify calibration results are within specification (±2% tolerance).
4. Load the test wafer onto the stage using the automated handler.
5. Select the 'E-Beam Inspection' recipe from the recipe library.
6. Configure detection sensitivity to target Voids defects.
7. Set scan parameters: full wafer scan with edge exclusion of 3mm.
8. Initiate the inspection run and monitor real-time defect map.
9. Upon completion, review the defect density map and classification results.
10. Export results to the factory automation system (SECS/GEM interface).
11. Compare results against the golden reference baseline.
12. Document any anomalies and generate the summary report.
sections.5_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA:
- Defect detection sensitivity must meet 65nm node requirements
- False positive rate shall not exceed 5% of total detected events
- Scan throughput must be ≥ 55 wafers per hour
- Classification accuracy shall be ≥ 94% for known defect types
- Repeatability (3-sigma) shall be within ±2.9% for E-Beam Inspection
- System uptime during test shall be ≥ 98%
- All results must be traceable through the MES integration
- Measurement correlation with reference tool shall be ≥ 0.96 R²
sections.6_TEST_RESULTS:
Test Execution Date: 2024-11-11
Wafers Tested: 50
Total Defects Found: 1898
Defect Density: 604.15 defects/cm²
Nuisance Rate: 0.6%
Capture Rate: 94.2%
Test Duration: 80 minutes
System Uptime: 96.7%

Result Classification: FAIL
sections.7_OBSERVATIONS:
a) The ATL/LMS IPRO8 demonstrated below-target performance in detecting Voids at the 65nm node.

b) The capture rate exceeded the minimum threshold, confirming system readiness.

c) Nuisance rate is within acceptable limits.

d) Minor calibration drift was detected after extended run; re-calibration resolved the issue.

e) The defect review station correlation was within specification.
sections.8_CORRECTIVE_ACTIONS:
The following corrective actions are recommended:

1. Re-tune detection algorithm thresholds for Voids at 65nm node.
2. Schedule follow-up test after recipe optimization.
3. Escalate to R&D for algorithm enhancement if re-tuning does not resolve sensitivity gap.
